title: A thrown monster pushes with all its speed, a thrown rock with 0.3
description: The player throws a rock at a charging caveman: it stuns the caveman and knocks it back a little, with 0.3 of the rock's speed. He picks the stunned caveman up and throws it on the run into a yeti, which takes all of the caveman's speed and flies to the far wall.
